store.name: Soi Dermatology
store.address: 5F, 21 Myeongdong 8-gil, Jung-gu, Seoul (Myeongdong Station, Exit 8, 2 min walk)

settings.holidays: Open on public holidays 10:00–17:00, except Seollal and Chuseok (closed).
settings.accessibility: Wheelchair accessible. Step-free entrance and elevator from street level to 5F. Accessible restroom on the same floor. Staff can assist from the building entrance on request.
settings.payment: Credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, JCB), Alipay, WeChat Pay. Tax refund available for foreign visitors on cosmetic procedures.
settings.medical: Counter does not give medical advice. Suitability for any procedure is decided by the doctor at the in-person consultation (included in the visit).
